title: Spring 2027 Science Externship – International Program
description:
Earthjustice is the nation's leading environmental law organization. We wield the power of law and the strength of partnership to protect people’s health, preserve magnificent places and wildlife, advance clean energy, and combat climate change. We are here because the Earth needs a good lawyer.
Driven by a passion for justice, inclusion, partnership, and excellence, our core values lead us to seek a broad range of perspectives and backgrounds to achieve our mission and maintain an inclusive environment where all staff are valued and respected.

Earthjustice ’s International Program is accepting applications for one part-time science extern for spring 2027. We are seeking graduate students who share a passion for justice and a healthy environment, and who are eligible to receive academic credit or fulfill a graduation requirement through this externship. The successful candidate may work remotely within the U.S. or on a hybrid schedule from our San Francisco, CA office.
The International Program partners with legal organizations in Latin America, Africa, Australia, and Indonesia to establish, strengthen, and enforce national and international legal protections for the environment, climate, and public health. The extern can expect to learn about, among other things, the impacts of energy projects, how environmental litigation takes shape in different countries, and the latest research in various environmental fields, such as climate change and air quality.
What You’ll Do
Under the supervision of the Staff Scientist, the extern will 1) research and analyze energy projects and policies and draft memos summarizing their findings; 2) support efforts to compile and synthesize work across geographical teams; and 3) occasionally help with key litigation tasks such as cite checking.
What You’ll Bring

• Enrolled in a graduate environmental science (or related field) program with an expected graduation date between May 2027 and May 2028.

• Must be eligible to receive academic credit or fulfill a graduation requirement through this externship.

• Working knowledge of MS Office Suite and comfort navigating and learning new tools.

• Outstanding research skills, including ability to conduct scientific literature reviews and basic quantitative data analyses.

• Strong written and verbal communication skills with ability to present complex information to various audiences.

• Demonstrated commitment to Earthjustice ’s values of Justice, Excellence, Inclusion, and Partnership.

• Must commit to at least 10 hours/week for 12-16 weeks.

Compensation :
Externs are unpaid and must receive academic credit or fulfill a graduation requirement for their work with Earthjustice .
To Apply:
Interested candidates should submit the following materials by Friday, September 18 at 5:00pm PT via Jobvite. Incomplete applications will not be considered. Applications will be reviewed beginning September 21 with offers extended no later than November 13.

• Resume.

• One-page cover letter that addresses: (1) Why you want to work with Earthjustice ’s International Program, (2) Note the number of hours, or a reasonable estimate, you will be able to work each week; (3) Confirm that you can earn academic credit from your school or that you will fulfill a graduation requirement through this externship; and (4) An indication of any applicable deadlines or requirements that are relevant to your ability to accept an offer.

• Additional Documents (select “Add Files” in Jobvite): (1) Proof of enrollment in your academic program (e.g., verification from your registrar’s office, unofficial transcript), and (2) Writing sample of up to 10 pages that illustrates the applicant’s ability to analyze an environmental issue. Please include a cover page indicating the extent to which your writing sample reflects edits and feedback from others as well as whether artificial intelligence was used in the drafting or editing of your writing sample.

title: Hybrid QA Engineer
description:

Sporty isn’t like other organisations that just see QA as a blocker - we give our QA team members the power you need to do your job, including deciding what is ready for launch and what needs more work. You will be acting as a Hybrid QA Engineer, contributing across both manual testing and test automation. You will be involved at every step of the development process, from requirements capture and estimation, all the way through to final testing, launching and maintenance of each of the features you are involved in. • DB: MySQL / Mongo DB

• DevOps: AWS / Jenkins / GitHub Actions / K8S

• Web: Selenium / Playwright / Postman

• Mobile: Appium / Android Studio / XCode

• Management: Jira / TestRail

• Testing (black box, white box, integration, and performance) of the Web, Android and iOS platforms

• Track and record product issues using Atlassian Jira and analyse the problems through various tools, giving feedback to relevant personnel to make corrections

What you'll bring

• 5+ years of experience in software quality assurance, including significant hands-on experience in test automation using Python

• Strong Python programming skills, including designing and maintaining test automation frameworks

• Solid understanding of testing types (integration, end-to-end, regression, performance, and API testing), test design techniques and quality processes

• Experience with Web / Android / iOS and API manual testing

• Experience with web debugging and API testing tools (Chrome DevTools, Postman)

• Working knowledge of relational databases, preferably MySQL

• Experience in automation testing of REST APIs

• Experience in automation testing of mobile apps (Android and iOS)

• Experience in automation testing of web apps (Selenium/Playwright)

• Experience with Docker

• Experience integrating automated tests into CI/CD pipelines and contributing to release quality gates

• Experience working within Agile/Scrum development environments, participating in sprint planning, backlog refinement, daily stand-ups, reviews, and retrospectives

Was dieser Job ist, steht unten. Was er nicht ist, auch.

Du nimmst Störungen unserer Geschäftskunden an - per Telefon, per Remote-Support und bei Bedarf vor Ort beim Kunden.

Bei uns ist First Level kein Endzustand.
Je sicherer du in einem Thema wirst, desto mehr davon bekommst du. Konkret heißt das: zuerst einzelne Second-Level-Themen, dann Verantwortung für feste Kunden, dann ein eigener technischer Schwerpunkt - zum Beispiel Netzwerk, Microsoft 365, Server, Firewall oder Cloud.

title: Head of Applied AI
description:
Head of Applied AI

Location: Our offices are in Central London, along with several of our customers. Travel to our customer sites is required, the frequency of which will vary from customer-to-customer. You need to be able to travel onsite to London up to 3 days per week, although onsite requirements will vary week-to-week and customer-to-customer from 0 to 3 days.

Salary: Competitive (DOE)

Defence/SC Clearance Requirements:

SC clearance is required for our customer facing teams. You do not need active SC clearance as we will undertake checks upon you joining, but you must be eligible to pass SC clearance. DV clearance may be required for certain roles, so the ability/willingness to pass DV clearance is advantageous but not essential.

About Cloudscaler

Cloudscaler is a rapidly growing cloud consultancy. We partner with ambitious enterprise and public sector customers to design, build, operate, and support secure, governed cloud platforms that meet the highest regulatory and industry standards.

We are scaling deliberately. Our revenue ambition depends on deploying the right people onto the right work quickly, and on making disciplined use of our capacity. This role is central to that.

 

About the role

Cloudscaler's Applied AI business unit launched at the start of 2026 and has grown quickly, with an established offering, live client engagements and a pipeline in place. The current Head of Applied AI is stepping back from the role for personal reasons and remains with the business to hand over, so the incoming Head inherits a running unit rather than a standing start. We are recruiting to take it into its next phase of growth.

The work is running; the structure is not yet. Offerings are defined, collateral exists, engagements are live and Cloudscaler's public voice on applied AI is established. What does not yet exist is the shape around it: there is no ring-fenced team, no separate P&L and no formally defined roles. The unit began with strategy, technical expertise and sales all held in one place. Technical capability has grown since; strategy and commercial ownership have not. Formalising the practice - defining the team, the roles and the commercial structure - is part of the job rather than something the incoming Head inherits finished.

This role has both external and internal responsibilities:

Externally, it owns our AI go-to-market offerings and the customer, partner and pre-sales activity that turns them into pipeline, and it is Cloudscaler's public voice on applied AI.

Internally, it carries full commercial accountability for the business unit, provides technical delivery oversight, builds and leads the practice, and is accountable for enabling the whole company to work with AI.

The role reports to the CTO and works closely with leadership across the business. The person needs to be technical enough to direct and challenge the engineering work, and commercially credible enough to scale the unit and its offering.

It is a hands-on role. In one week, you might write a business case for the Leadership Team, advise a client CTO on their AI strategy, review an engineer's architecture decision and speak at a conference on what we have learned.

External responsibilities

These responsibilities are customer-facing, partner-facing and public facing:

Relentless client focus - Maintaining a relentless client focus, calibrated to how mature the business unit is, and being decisive about where to concentrate effort and what to stop. Early on that means client meetings and pipeline growth; later it means shifting weight to larger, more sustainable areas of demand.

AI go-to-market offerings - Defining and owning our AI go-to-market offerings, working with sales to take them to market. For each offering, defining what it is, who buys it, the problem it solves, its indicative price and its delivery model, and reviewing the set as the market moves, retiring what no longer sells and evolving what does.

title: Special Projects Manager
description:
ABOUT ZEGO 🚀

At Zego, we're on a mission to do the good thing, not the insurance thing.

Insurance hasn't changed much in over a century. The way we live, work and travel has. We're building the real-time, AI-driven infrastructure that powers innovative insurance, so good drivers get cover that works the way they actually drive.

We're not just updating insurance. We're leading the AI evolution in insurance 🤖. For us, AI isn't a line on a roadmap or a buzzword on a slide. It's our operating reality, and it's how we build products that back drivers instead of the old insurance playbook.

We don't do things slowly, and we don't do bureaucracy. We back high-performance builders who want ownership, early responsibility and the chance to do the most career-defining work of their lives. You'll get the space to try things, the tools to move fast, and the room to see your ideas reach millions of drivers.

Do not take our word for it. Read what Zegons say about us on Glassdoor https://www.glassdoor.co.uk/Overview/Working-at-Zego-Insurance-EI_IE1851459.11,25.htm.

If you're ready to build the future of insurance, we're hiring.

ABOUT THE ROLE

Reports to Zego's Deputy CEO.

This role exists to take on the problems that don't fit anywhere else. No two quarters will look the same. One might be launching a new product line. The next, building the framework and analysis that decides where we invest. Then designing an AI system that replaces a manual process, taking over a business unit and running it, leading a cross functional programme nobody else can unblock, or building the story we take to shareholders, investors and the Board.

It's the fastest way to understand how a leading AI company actually works: tech, product, marketing, operations, finance, regulation. You'll work directly with the people who run each of them.

WHAT YOU WILL BE DOING

- Whole problems, not work-streams. You take something ambiguous, scope it, build the plan, win the buy-in, deliver it, then either hand it over or run it. Launching a new product. Rebuilding a revenue line that has stalled. Standing up a capability from nothing.

- Decisions worth making. You'll use quantitative and qualitative evidence to work out what's really going on, then make the call and defend it in front of the leadership team. Analysis that doesn't impact a decision isn't the job.

- AI that does real work. You'll design and build AI systems and workflows that take work off people's plates, in content, analysis, operations or reporting. We expect you to reach for AI first, and to be the person others copy.

- The narrative. Company wide updates, investor material, Board packs. You'll turn complicated business reality into something a smart outsider can follow in ten minutes.

WHAT YOU WILL NEED TO BE SUCCESSFUL

- Proof you've done something hard. A business you built, a product you launched, a number you moved, a broken thing you fixed. We care about what happened, not what you were responsible for.

- Real AI fluency. You've built your own tools, agents or workflows, not just used a chatbot. Come ready to show us.

- Speed with judgement. You've worked somewhere genuinely fast, most likely a high growth startup, strategy consulting or similar and you know the difference between impact and effort.

- Comfort with numbers and with people. You can build the model, then sit with an underwriter, a regulator or a shareholder and be taken seriously in both rooms.

- Ownership as an instinct. Nobody will hand you a brief, a template or a team. You'll find the work, prioritise it and finish it.

- Communication that lands. Clear writing, clear slides, clear thinking, in front of any audience from an engineer to the Board.

- You work AI-first. You will use AI daily here, and we mean daily. You do not need to arrive an expert, but you do need to arrive curious, experiment fast, and take ownership of getting good quickly. People who wait to be trained will find this uncomfortable.

THE ZEGO

In this role, you will sit at the intersection of cloud infrastructure and software integration. You will be responsible for the health, security, and connectivity of our core platforms, ensuring that data flows cleanly across our ecosystem.
A note on experience with our specific platforms. This is a technical role and it requires real technical ability. You need to be able to read and write code, reason about how systems talk to each other, and work confidently in a command line, a log file, and an API. What you do not need is prior experience in Salesforce, AWS, or any other product on this page. Those are learnable, and we will teach them to you. If you have a solid technical foundation and a track record of picking up unfamiliar systems quickly, do not screen yourself out because you have never touched a Salesforce org.

Investigation, Requirements, and Solutioning

• Problem Investigation: Take ambiguous requests and unclear symptoms, trace them back to root cause, and explain what you found in plain language.

• Requirements Gathering: Sit with stakeholders across the business, ask the questions that surface what they actually need (not just what they asked for), and turn that into a clear set of requirements.

• Solution Design: Evaluate options, weigh tradeoffs, and recommend an approach. Then build it, test it, and see it through.

• Documentation: Maintain clear, up-to-date technical documentation for system architecture, integration mappings, and workflow logic.

Systems & Cloud Administration

Integrations & Automation

• Scripting & Automation: Write logic and scripts that automate manual workflows and improve data synchronization.

• Technical Troubleshooting: Identify and resolve integration failures or API bottlenecks to ensure high system availability.

Stakeholder Management & Prioritization

• Prioritization: Manage a diverse queue of technical tasks, balancing immediate support needs with long-term infrastructure projects.

• A solid understanding of API architecture: what REST and SOAP are, how authentication works, what a payload looks like, and how two systems exchange data.

• Comfort working in a technical environment: command line, log files, stack traces, and vendor documentation.

• Foundational understanding of core IT and cloud concepts such as networking basics, user access and permissions models, and security practices.

Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. At Anduril, maintenance isn't an afterthought - it's the backbone that keeps our high-throughput, automation-
heavy factories running. As we scale production at Arsenal-1, our new manufacturing campus in Ashville, Ohio,
we are standing up the site maintenance organization for Building 1 from a blank sheet of paper.
We are looking for a Senior Manager of Maintenance to own that build end to end. This is the senior site leader
accountable for the maintenance and reliability of Arsenal-1 Building 1 as it ramps to multi-program, two-shift
production supporting Fury, Barracuda, Altius, Roadrunner, and additional advanced programs. You will set the
maintenance strategy, design and staff the organization, build the leadership team beneath you, stand up the
preventive maintenance and spare parts programs, and establish the reliability culture that everything
downstream depends on. As a member of the site operations leadership team, you will represent maintenance

along with skilled-trades technicians (electrical/controls, mechanical/millwright, and facilities) and
planners/schedulers spanning administrative, tactical, and strategic roles.

reliability strategies for a mixed environment of manual and automated assembly, machining and
fabrication, and building/facility systems.

set stocking levels and reorder points, establish the storeroom, own the maintenance operating and capital
budget, and build OEM and supplier relationships to protect uptime.

facilities on equipment installation, commissioning, spare-parts provisioning, and maintainability from day

• Roll up your sleeves - work shoulder-to-shoulder with manufacturing on the floor, and get hands-on when
it counts, especially in the early stand-up phase.

The Opportunity
As Senior Director of AI Engineering, you will lead innovation and strategic growth across FICO 's platform. Working at the forefront of our Generative AI efforts, you'll drive the application of large language models and cutting-edge AI technologies to enhance fraud detection, streamline decision authoring, automate customer communication workflows, and optimize overall performance. You will set the technical vision for our AI systems, ensuring they are robust, scalable, and responsibly governed. Most importantly, you'll lead a high-performing engineering team to deliver transformative AI solutions that address real business challenges and advance FICO 's platform capabilities.
What You'll Contribute

• Lead, develop, and coach a high-performing engineering team by fostering a culture of aligned autonomy, clear communication, and continuous learning - while actively recruiting top talent and setting clear direction for hiring strategies.

• Drive the design and implementation of AI solutions - including LLM-powered decision automation, fraud detection, and process optimization - to strengthen FICO 's position as a market leader.

• Partner with stakeholders and product managers to understand business priorities and translate them into actionable engineering roadmaps that harness advanced AI capabilities for meaningful outcomes.

• Define best practices for model evaluation, governance, and monitoring to ensure AI systems remain accurate, reliable, secure, and compliant at scale.

• Build and maintain systems for continuous model monitoring, A/B testing, backtesting, and drift detection to keep deployed models performing at their best over time.

• Collaborate closely with UX designers, product teams, and engineering leaders to align AI capabilities across the platform and deliver a cohesive user experience.

What We're Seeking

• Proven experience building and leading engineering teams to deliver advanced AI solutions, with deep expertise in Large Language Models and their application to decision automation, fraud detection, and process optimization.

• 15+ years of industry experience in software, machine learning, or data engineering, with a demonstrated history of leading complex, large-scale projects and applying LLMs to solve real-world challenges.

• A track record of effective leadership, coaching, and mentoring that fosters innovation, accountability, and a high-performance culture in dynamic, fast-paced environments.

• Hands-on experience with model fine-tuning, in-context learning, and custom evaluation frameworks, alongside a strong command of backtesting, A/B testing, and drift detection methodologies to ensure reliable model performance in production.

• Solid understanding of model monitoring, governance, and compliance practices, with a commitment to responsible AI and the ability to architect scalable, secure, AI and data-driven systems that meet rigorous production standards.

• Familiarity with compliance and regulatory requirements in AI-driven decisioning environments, and a working knowledge of modern software engineering practices and design patterns.

• Strong cross-functional collaboration skills, with the ability to work across departments and align engineering efforts to broader business goals.

• Thought leadership in AI and machine learning - through publications, patents, or open-source contributions - is a plus.

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Data Science, AI, or a related field.

Our Offer to You

• An inclusive culture strongly reflecting our core values: Act Like an Owner, Delight Our Customers and Earn the Respect of Others.

- Regularly report on the performance of the feedback loop, including key insights, trends, and actionable recommendations for the product roadmap.

title: Adjunct Faculty- Clinical Psychopharmacology- Online Campus
description:
Job Description:
Founded in 1979, The Chicago School is an independent professional graduate school with a dynamic student body and a professionally accomplished faculty. Our curriculum and training opportunities prepare graduates to deliver outstanding professional services emphasizing the ability to understand and work with diverse populations.

Position Summary:

The Master of Science in Clinical Psychopharmacology Program (APA designated) at The Chicago School is currently seeking qualified individuals to teach courses in the curriculum. All online courses at The Chicago School are 7 weeks long and are taught in the Canvas Learning Management System.

The Clinical Psychopharmacology Program is seeking qualified Adjunct Faculty to teach the following courses:

• Clinical Anatomy and Integrated Science

• Advanced Pathophysiology

• Clinical Biochemistry and Neurochemistry

• Pharmacology

• Advanced Physical Assessment

• Diagnostic Methods (i.e., laboratory and neuroradiological imaging

Principal Duties:

The primary responsibility of adjunct faculty members is to enrich courses by sharing theoretical and practical knowledge of the subject, encouraging direct application to the workplace within the field of Clinical Psychopharmacology.

All Online adjunct faculty members at The Chicago School are expected to be available (online) and responsive to students five out of seven days during the course of the week. This “availability” includes:

• Active participation in the discussion forum;

• Posting course-related announcement(s);

• Timely grading of assignments and providing quality feedback;

• Holding virtual office hours.

In addition, it is expected that all adjunct faculty members adhere to the following duties during a 7-week term:

• Posting a welcome message to all students outlining weekly virtual office hours.

• Creating a video welcome message and post to Canvas course site.

• Holding one voluntary conference call or synchronous chat each term, either via Skype or GoToMeeting software (account information provided by the Department Manager).

• Responding to each student’s initial post in a discussion forum.

• Grading quizzes and providing feedback on short assignments within 48 hours.

• Providing grading and feedback on larger assignments within 3 days after due date.

• Responding to all student email(s) within 24 hours.

• Issuing final grade on time (by Tuesday midnight after Week 7 ends).

• All online adjunct faculty are required to complete an 8-week training course reviewing online pedagogy best practices prior to teaching their assigned courses.

Position Qualifications:

• Doctoral degree in Clinical Psychology, Medical Studies, Pharmaceutical Science, or a related discipline

• Formal degree in Pharmacology or Clinical Psychopharmacology

• Professional license preferred (pharmacy, physician, or prescribing psychologist)

• Board Certification preferred

• Previous online teaching experience (3 years preferred);

• Exemplary professional experience

• Engagement in research and scholarship (preferred)

The department seeks an individual who has the ability and interest in contributing to a community committed to student-centeredness, professional development and scholarship, integrity and ethics, respect for diversity and pluralism, innovation, flexibility, and teamwork and collaboration. Candidates who will advance equity, diversity, and inclusion through their teaching, scholarship, and service are strongly encouraged to apply.

At Swapcard , we believe in the power of meaningful connections. This belief fuels our commitment to pioneering modern solutions that empower organizers to create engaging event experiences.
Guided by our commitment to excellence and collaboration, we aim to redefine the landscape of event technology, setting new standards for engagement, accessibility, and impact.

At Swapcard , diversity is at the core of our success. With 42 nationalities represented among our 180+ team members, we champion diversity as a catalyst for creativity, collaboration, and unparalleled innovation.
We believe that by embracing a multitude of backgrounds, cultures, and viewpoints, we can truly understand and cater to the needs of our global community of event organizers and participants.
Our full remote opportunities empower our team to thrive, no matter where they are in the world, fostering a culture of flexibility and inclusion.

Role Summary:

It is a very unique and challenging role and provides immense opportunity to design and develop wide-reaching tools. This role merges the technical core of test automation engineering with hands-on quality validation and technical issue triage. You will design scalable test frameworks while serving as the primary engineering bridge for reproducing and resolving high-priority customer defects.

What you will be doing

• You will be primarily responsible for writing frameworks and tests to test product & any third party integrations.

• Maintain, enhance and extend complex Python&Selenium frameworks.

• Create and execute comprehensible, repeatable and measurable automated regression test suites for Web applications.

• Identify, evaluate, report and document defects during the design and implementation phase.

• Analyze, reproduce and report bugs reported by customers, being a proxy between customer needs and developer reading.

• Participate in the full software development lifecycle and ensure quality all the way to production systems.

• Support cross-functional squads with quality check, ensuring implementation fully meets functional requirements by performing manual testing and adapting test automation solution.

Must have

• 1+ years software developer in test experience.

• Good written, verbal, organizational, and analytical skills.

• Experience in Python and Selenium, with test automation frameworks and maintaining tests with Pytest, working with codebase using Git or similar technologies.

• Working in the EET (Eastern European Time) time zone.

• Eager to learn and grow professionally

Nice to have

• Hands-on experience with SOAP and REST APIs.

• Experience with Jenkins and Postman.

Swapcard ’s Interview process
Our thorough interview process aims to identify exceptional talent to advance our mission while offering you a chance to explore your career potential at Swapcard .
1. Screening Interview with a recruiter from our people team.
2. A remote exercise to demonstrate and assess your skills.
3. Manager review with your future reporting manager
4. Leadership review with one of our department leaders
5. Reference check conducted by our people team
6. Offer

Swapcard 's Values
🧠 Curious : We ask questions, try new things and take risks. We learn from one another and see mistakes as opportunities to grow-what matters most is how we react and learn from them. We are curious about what something is and why something is. Innovation thrives when curiosity drives.
🗝️ Value-Driven: At Swapcard , we focus on making each decision count by prioritising outcomes that create meaningful value for our customers, team members, and partners.

title: Project Manager, People Initiatives
description:
As Project Manager on our People & Culture (P&C) team, you'll bring structure, accountability and a human touch to the projects shaping Booksy 's global team experience. Reporting to the Chief People Officer, you'll help our P&C Leadership team break down silos and apply our resources with intention across our centres of excellence.
You'll own delivery of the P&C Roadmap: leading weekly reviews, facilitating status updates and gathering feedback to drive continuous improvement. Working across teams, you'll manage planning and budget processes, report to stakeholders inside and beyond P&C, and keep our global initiatives on course. It's less about managing tasks than keeping an eye on the bigger picture; helping the team thrive as we pursue efficiency gains and opportunities with AI.
This isn't a typical Project Manager role. We want someone who holds their own, challenges our P&C leadership and acts as a sounding board, and keeps our RACI model honest. If something's off track or blocked, you flag it, you don't wait to be asked. You're solution-oriented by default, generating ways to unblock rather than simply escalating.
It’s important that you see ambiguity and significant change as exciting; not just for the team, but for your own career, as we redefine People initiatives in the AI era.
Requirements
Essentially, to ensure you succeed in this role, you’re going to need:

• A proven track record of delivering complex people projects on time and within scope, within a similar tech scale-up environment..

• A formal Project Management qualification, such as Prince 2.

• Familiarity with project management and communication tools, specifically Asana, Miro and Slack, you’re also comfortable navigating AI tools like Gemini and Claude.

• Experience managing budgets and a structured, detail-oriented approach to delivery.

• The ability to context-switch quickly and juggle multiple timelines independently.

• Superb written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to collaborate across all levels of stakeholders..

A career at Booksy means you're part of a global team focused on helping people around the world feel great about themselves, every day. From empowering entrepreneurs to build successful businesses, to supporting their customers to arrange 'me time' moments, we're in the business of helping people thrive and feel fantastic.
Working in a rapidly evolving company comes with its own set of opportunities and challenges. However, if you're a driven self-starter with the motivation to grow your career in an environment that's rapidly changing as we scale-up globally, then the chances are that you'll love it at Booksy .

title: Associate Organizing Director
description:
About the role:

The Associate Organizing Director is a seasoned people manager who leads a team of ~5 organizing staff across multiple career levels. While this role focuses heavily on driving team performance, setting clear metrics, coaching for growth, and holding staff accountable to shared campaign goals, the Associate Organizing Director also provides strategic oversight for state field programs, campaign execution, and cross-department initiatives.

We are looking for an experienced organizing leader who loves people management and building and leading innovative programming in a rapidly growing progressive organization. The position involves some travel up to 20% each year, with ebbs and flows depending on the work.

Indivisible offers a comprehensive employer-sponsored benefits package, including medical, dental, and vision coverage; a company-sponsored Health Reimbursement Arrangement (HRA); FSA with limited matching, and a 401(k) retirement plan with up to a 5% employer match. Employees are fully vested upon becoming eligible.

What you'll do:

People and Culture - 60%

• Supervise ~5 organizing staff across multiple states and experience levels.

• Provide regular guidance, mentorship, structure, feedback, and evaluation to support team members’ ongoing growth.

• Use program metrics and tracking systems to manage individual staff performance, holding team members accountable to shared goals and addressing gaps early through proactive coaching.

• Contribute to a safe, welcoming, and inspiring environment for staff to excel in, and provide ongoing opportunities for team members to lead and grow. Build a unique and positive culture for your team.

• Uphold Indivisible's values of creating an inclusive and equitable working environment.

Program Management - 30%

• Independently or in partnership with other organizational leadership, lead priority programs and campaigns, both within our team and across departments, to help achieve organizational goals.

• Work with organizers across experience levels to develop strategic turf plans to hit campaign and organizational goals.

• Actively manage your team to achieve their goals - providing constructive feedback and guidance as they work towards them, creating opportunities to learn from both successes and setbacks, and holding staff accountable when they fall short.

Team Leadership - 10%

• Work with Organizing Leadership to continue to build and improve Indivisible's organizing model and strategy.

• Identify best practices both within the team and in the field, and work with leadership to scale them aggressively.

• Listen for and surface new departmental or organizational initiatives based on feedback from group leaders and/or staff.

Qualifications:

Field Expertise & Strategy

• Strong knowledge and at least 5-7 years/cycles of demonstrated experience developing and implementing field strategies; deep understanding of grassroots and grasstops organizing.

• Ability to develop and implement field plans, track/monitor/assess progress, troubleshoot, and adapt as needed.

• Ability to tackle big, complex problems with actionable plans, generate smart, innovative approaches, and not afraid to think outside of the box.

title: UX: Staff Product Designer, Design Systems - Visual
description:
Location : Home // Office // Flexible

Team : Design Language Systems // Product Platform Product Line

About the Team

People love using HubSpot because it’s an essential product that gives them the tools and insights they need to grow their business. Trellis is HubSpot's enterprise design system - the shared foundation that powers every product surface across CRM, Marketing Hub, Sales Hub, Service Hub, Commerce Hub, Breeze AI, and the growing portfolio of agentic experiences. Trellis is not a style guide or a Figma library. It is the connective tissue between design intent and product reality at scale: a living system of tokens, components, patterns, documentation, and tooling that thousands of designers and engineers across HubSpot depend on every day to build with speed, quality, and consistency.

We are at a defining inflection point. AI is fundamentally expanding what a design system is. In the AI-native era, Trellis must be machine-readable as well as human-readable: tokens need semantic structure that AI tools can reason about, documentation needs to serve both the designer using Figma and the AI coding tool generating product UI. This is the environment you're stepping into, and it is exactly the right moment to shape how HubSpot builds.

About this Role

The Staff Product Designer - Tokens & Visual Language is the foundational design role on the Trellis team. You are the DRI for the token architecture that every component, every pattern, and every product surface built on Trellis depends on. You are also the steward of HubSpot's product design language - the visual grammar of color, typography, spacing, iconography, and motion that makes HubSpot's product experiences feel coherent, polished, and distinctly HubSpot.

This is not a role where you maintain what exists. You will inherit a token foundation and evolve it to meet requirements that didn't exist when it was built: multi-theme support, dark mode, density scaling, AI-generated product surfaces that need token constraints baked into their toolchain, and a platform that is migrating five major product surfaces simultaneously. You will make architectural decisions that cascade across the entire system - decisions that require the judgment to be right, the craft to be defensible, and the authority to hold the quality bar when product team urgency pushes against it.

We’re looking for a strategically-minded, outcomes-oriented design leader to own and evolve our Design System. In this role, you’ll:

• Design and steward the three-tier token graph - global, semantic, and component-specific - ensuring it scales to meet multi-theme, multi-platform, and multi-density requirements across the full HubSpot product surface

• Make and defend architectural token decisions: naming conventions, tier boundaries, semantic abstraction levels, and the tradeoffs between flexibility and constraint that determine how well the system scales

• Manage token migrations without breaking downstream consumers - designing safe, phased rollout processes and the governance model that keeps consuming teams aligned

• Own the visual language of Trellis: the system-level decisions in color, typography, spacing, iconography, and motion that make HubSpot's product experiences feel intentional, cohesive, and distinctly HubSpot

• Serve as the "final eye" on visual quality: hold the aesthetic quality bar for a system consumed by hundreds of designers, and navigate disagreements about visual direction with clarity, craft evidence, and authority

• Develop and communicate design principles and tenets that give your team and consuming designers a framework for navigating visual decisions without requiring alignment overhead on every choice

• Lead the effort to make the Trellis token layer machine-readable: structuring token names and documentation in formats that AI coding tools, MCP integrations, and generative UI systems can consume and apply correctly

• Partner with product teams across Hubspot

title: Member of Technical Staff - Lead, Storage
description:
ABOUT US:

AI needs a new infrastructure layer. We're building it at Modal.

Every era of computing brought new workloads that previous infrastructure couldn't support: mainframes, databases, and the cloud. Each time, the company that rebuilt the layer underneath defined the decade. AI is no different, except it touches everything instead of one slice, and the window to build the layer underneath it is open right now.

Our customers include category-defining companies like Lovable https://modal.com/blog/lovable-case-study, Ramp https://modal.com/blog/how-ramp-built-a-full-context-background-coding-agent-on-modal, Cognition, DoorDash, and Suno. They rely on Modal for instant GPU access, sub-second container starts, and native storage, so it's simple to serve low-latency inference, fine-tune models, and access production-ready sandboxes at scale.

We recently raised a $355M Series C https://modal.com/blog/modal-series-c at a $4.65B valuation, led by General Catalyst and Redpoint Ventures. We've crossed $300M+ ARR and grown fivefold since September.

Our team includes creators of popular open-source projects (e.g.,Seaborn https://github.com/mwaskom/seaborn,Luigi https://github.com/spotify/luigi), academic researchers, international olympiad medalists, and experienced engineering and product leaders with decades of experience.

THE ROLE:

We are looking for a strong technical lead to guide the engineers designing, building, and maintaining the novel, high-performance systems that make up our serverless platform. You'll lead the team responsible for the distributed object storage system that underpins every container image, volume, and checkpoint on Modal: hundreds of petabytes of data, replicated across multiple cloud object stores and a CDN, cached on local NVMe across a large fleet of workers in many datacenters, and shared peer-to-peer within each datacenter. You'll set technical direction for the primitives that other teams (filesystems, training, sandboxes) build on, balancing durability, latency, throughput, and cost. You'll own the roadmap from today's hardest problems (garbage collection at petabyte scale, active-active replication, rate limiting that protects the upstream without wasting utilization) to the architectural bets that decide what blobnet becomes: storage colocated with the GPUs, tiered writes, and capacity planning against provider limits. You'll manage a team of 3-8 engineers while staying hands-on across the stack, from local disk and page cache to distributed blob storage and garbage collection, and you'll guide the observability, automation, and on-call practices that keep the system healthy as it grows by orders of magnitude.

REQUIREMENTS:

- 7+ years of experience writing high-quality production code

- 3+ years of direct people management experience, ideally leading a team of engineers through project planning, growth, and performance conversations

- Experience building high-performance distributed storage or caching systems at a large scale (the more challenges you've worked through, the better)

- Strong cloud skills, including deep familiarity with object storage (S3 or similar), CDNs, and their consistency, throughput, and cost characteristics

- Strong knowledge of low-level operating system foundations (Linux kernel, file systems, page cache, containers, etc.)

- Experience with replication, content addressing, and consistency models in multi-region or multi-cloud systems

- Experience operating storage systems at scale (petabyte-scale datasets, high-throughput read/write paths, large-scale garbage collection or data migration), including owning cost and capacity planning

- Track record of setting technical direction and driving architectural decisions across a team, and of building the primitives other teams depend on

- Willingness to step into the thick of it with our on-call rotation and respond to production incidents

NICE-TO-HAVES:

- Experience with data engineering at petabyte-scale.

In 2018, we began with a WhatsApp group with a simple hypothesis: people in tier-2/3 towns weren’t really using the internet meaningfully yet. We believed that if we started with local content in their own language, they’d come back every day; once there was a habit and trust, that same space could naturally grow into classifieds and, eventually, something they used for almost everything online.This spark became Lokal . Our first instinct was to put everything in one place & one app - local updates, classifieds, jobs, matrimony and more. It worked, till it stopped working. Users gave us the insight - when one use case outweighs the others, everything else seems like noise. We listened. Like how Craigslist quietly seeded a generation of focused companies & marketplaces, we began unbundling and verticalising.
Today, Lokal is a house of focused apps, many products, one mission:

• Familiarity with autonomous driving and motion planning.

title: Senior Application Security Engineer
description:
About the role

We are looking for a Sr. Full Stack Application Security Engineer with deep expertise in mobile application security to join our Product Security team. This role is hands-on and impact driven. You will work directly with mobile, backend, and platform engineering teams to identify, prevent, and remediate security issues across our iOS, Android, API, and backend systems.

You will operate close to the code and close to the product. That means reviewing architectures across the stack, influencing secure design decisions early, and helping teams ship features safely without slowing delivery. This role is for someone who understands how modern distributed systems and mobile apps are built, deployed, and attacked in real-world environments.

While mobile application security is a core focus, you will be part of a team that owns security posture across the full application stack including APIs, backend services, identity and authentication flows, and CI/CD pipelines.

The base salary offered for this role and level of experience will begin at $213,000 and up to $295,000. Full-time employees are also eligible for a bonus, competitive equity package, and benefits. The actual base salary offered may be higher, depending on your location, skills, qualifications, and experience. 

In this role, you can expect to

• Build and improve security capabilities, automation, and guardrails for mobile applications and backend/API services

• Perform application or API/backend penetration testing 

• Identify, triage, and help remediate vulnerabilities across Chime products

• Partner closely with engineering and product teams to embed security into the development lifecycle across mobile apps, APIs, and backend services

• Perform architecture and code reviews across the stack (iOS/Android, APIs, backend) with a focus on secure data storage, authentication, authorization, secure communication, and session/token handling

• Leverage AI to accelerate security workflows (e.g., code review support, triage, threat modeling), and partner with teams building AI-enabled features to define and implement production-grade AI security controls 

To thrive in this role, you have

• 5+ years of experience in application security, with strong hands-on experience across both mobile and backend systems 

• Hands on experience securing iOS and Android applications in production environments

• Strong understanding of mobile threat models and common attack techniques

• Experience with mobile security testing techniques, including static and dynamic analysis

• Familiarity with iOS and Android platform security features and limitations

• Practical coding experience, preferably in Ruby, Go, Python  languages

• Ability to clearly communicate security risks, tradeoffs, and remediation guidance to engineering partners

title: Staff Machine Learning Engineer, Ads Creative Effectiveness
description:
Reddit is a community of communities. It’s built on shared interests, passion, and trust, and is home to the most open and authentic conversations on the internet. Every day, Reddit users submit, vote, and comment on the topics they care most about. With 100,000+ active communities and approximately 130 million daily active unique visitors, Reddit is one of the internet’s largest sources of information. For more information, visit www.redditinc.com .

About the Role

Reddit’s Ads Creative Effectiveness team sits at the heart of our creative strategy, building GenAI and predictive products that help advertisers ship high-impact campaigns. We are searching for a Staff engineer with in-depth GenAI expertise that can help us build the future of generative products for ad creative at Reddit - best-in-class image, video and copy generators that leverage Reddit’s best practices, performance-guided generations that maximize clicks and conversions, and brand safe, product preserving image/video editing pipelines.

What you’ll do:

• Advanced Generative Workflows: Architect and implement state-of-the-art pipelines for ad creative generation. You will move beyond vanilla prompting to build systems capable of product, font, logo and brand asset preservation using techniques like IP-Adapters, and LoRAs.

• End-to-End Image & Video Editing: Build editing capabilities allowing advertisers to smart-crop, inpaint, outpaint, resize, and style-transfer assets while maintaining strict brand guidelines.

• LLM/VLM Fine-Tuning: Adapt large vision-language models to understand "winning" ad aesthetics. You will build feedback loops where ad performance metrics (CTR, CVR) are used to fine-tune the generation process (RLHF/RLPF for Ads).

• Safety & Compliance Layer: engineer robust filtering and safety systems. You ensure our models never generate non-compliant, unsafe, or copyright-infringing content.

• Partner Broadly: Collaborate with Product, Sales, Policy, UX, and sibling Ads ML teams to integrate ACE capabilities into the Ad Manager UI and the ad delivery path.

• Guardrails & Safety: Embed brand-safety filters, copyright checks, and human-in-the-loop escalation paths to protect users and advertisers.

What we’re looking for:

• Deep ML Expertise: Hands-on experience with tree models, neural nets, ranking, and especially LLM/VLM fine-tuning & RLHF/RLPF for ads.

• Quant & Experimentation Chops: Comfort with uplift metrics, variance, minimum detectable effects and experimentation setups for generative systems.

• Ads / Marketplace Insight: Understanding auction dynamics and advertiser pain points to create tools that drive revenue and retention.

• Startup Mindset: Bias to action, comfort with ambiguity, and scrappiness: ACE evolved from a startup acquisition and still moves fast.

• Communication Superpowers: Able to distill complex ML trade-offs for executives, product managers, and non-technical stakeholders alike.

• Prior work on ad creative tooling: Headline generators, image generators, pre-test models, editing flows for the advertiser.

Nice-to-have

• Experience navigating brand-safety, privacy, or copyright frameworks in generative AI products.

• Comprehensive Healthcare Benefits and Income Replacement Programs

• 401k with Employer Match

• Global Benefit programs that fit your lifestyle, from workspace to professional development to caregiving support

• Family Planning Support

• Gender-Affirming Care

• Mental Health & Coaching Benefits

• Flexible Vacation & Paid Volunteer Time Off

• Generous Paid Parental Leave

This job posting may span more than one career level.

In addition to base salary, this job is eligible to receive equity in the form of restricted stock units, and depending on the position offered, it may also be eligible to receive a commission. title: Analytics Engineer
description:
ABOUT US

At LangChain, our mission is to make intelligent agents ubiquitous. We build the foundation for agent engineering in the real world, helping developers move from prototypes to production-ready AI agents that teams can rely on. We began as widely adopted open-source tools and have grown to also offer a platform for building, evaluating, deploying, and operating agents at scale.

With $125M raised at Series B from IVP, Sequoia, Benchmark, CapitalG, and Sapphire Ventures, we’re at a stage where we’re continuing to develop new products, growth is accelerating, and all team members have meaningful impact on what we build and how we work together. LangChain is a place where your contributions can shape how this technology shows up in the real world.

Today, our platform includes LangSmith (Observability, Evaluation, Deployment, Fleet, and Sandboxes), our open source frameworks (LangChain, LangGraph, and Deep Agents), and the newly launched LangSmith Engine for autonomous agent improvement. We have 100M+ monthly open source downloads, 6,000+ active LangSmith customers, and 5 of the Fortune 10 use LangSmith in production (+ 35% of the Fortune 500 overall), including teams at Klarna, Clay, Coinbase, Workday, Lyft, Cloudflare, Harvey, Rippling, Vanta, LinkedIn, Monday.com, Nvidia, and Bridgewater.

ABOUT THE ROLE:

We’re looking for an Analytics Engineer to join the team. We build products used by elite companies and over a million developers, and data plays a critical role in sharping our strategies and decision making. In this role you will help lay the foundation for business teams to diagnose issues, uncover opportunities, and drive success using data. If you enjoy building data infrastructure and empowering teams with actionable insights, this role is for you.

WHAT YOU WILL DO:

- Work with and expand on our foundational data stack - Looker, dbt, BigQuery, Airbyte

- Write LookML and dbt models that describe our business, powering a self-serve analytics experience

- Connect data from different sources (Salesforce, Stripe, Metronome, Clickhouse, etc) into our BigQuery warehouse

- Build dashboards that track progress against company goals and KPIs

- Analyze product usage and operational data to surface insights around customer health, adoption, and revenue

- Develop a deep understanding of our business metrics to drive alignment, prioritization, and decision-making

WHAT YOU'LL BRING:

- Have 3+ years experience in analytics engineering

- Have technical proficiency in BigQuery (or similar), dbt, Looker/ LookML, Airbyte (or similar), Segment

- Detail oriented, enjoys data spelunking, and can synthesize findings effectively

- Bring curiosity and a strong business sense to help anticipate needs and generate meaningful insights

- Start-up DNA with the ability fast-paced and unstructured environments

- You are self-directed - you don’t wait for process or oversight to start making an impact

Compensation & Benefits:

We offer competitive compensation that includes base salary, meaningful equity, and benefits such as health and dental coverage, flexible vacation, a 401(k) plan, and life insurance. Actual compensation will vary based on role, level, and location. For team members in the EU and UK, we provide locally competitive benefits aligned with regional norms and regulations.

Annual salary range: $140,000-$175,000

Compensation Philosophy:

We offer competitive compensation that includes base salary, variable compensation for relevant roles, meaningful equity, benefits, and perks. Actual compensation and offerings will vary based on role, level, and location. Team members in the EU, UK, and APAC receive locally competitive benefits aligned with regional norms and regulations.

BENEFITS

Benefits include medical, dental, and vision coverage, flexible vacation, a 401(k) plan, meals on in-office days in the US and more.

title: Roaming Business Expert – Tieto Tech Consulting (m/f/d)
description:
Tieto Tech Consulting, is looking for a highly skilled and motivated Roaming Business Expert , a professional who will join a project within a Telecom Team for our respectful client BICS.
Join the team of our customer BICS - a global telecommunication enabler with a physical network stretching through the globe! Grow your expertise through interacting with A-level mobile carriers from all over the world. Get your hands on the vast network with on land, underwater, and space points of presence.Join our decade-long partnership with BICS to ensure confidence in your future and long-term growth! Tieto-BICS team has been growing since 2010… and we are looking forward to grow with you!

• Develop your telecom expertise in diverse portfolio of BICS products, including Voice, Cloud, Signaling, LTE, IoT, etc.

• Enjoy unmatched growth opportunities with BICS vast network and customers around the world.

Tieto - BICS team has been growing since 2010… and we are looking forward to growing with you!
Role Purpose:
The Roaming business Expert is responsible for representing the commercial interests of a designated customer in all roaming-related negotiations with international mobile network operators (MNOs). The role ensures that Inter-Operator Tariff (IOT) agreements are aligned with the customer’s strategic goals and budget expectations, while maintaining strong industry relationships and ensuring compliance with regulatory and contractual frameworks.
Responsibilities

•
Customer Representation:

• Act as the commercial voice of the customer in all IOT negotiations, ensuring their strategic and financial objectives are met.

• Translate customer P&L targets into negotiation strategies and commercial outcomes.

•
Negotiation & Contract Management:

• Lead bilateral and multilateral negotiations with roaming partners and groups to secure optimal IOT terms.

• Ensure contracts reflect agreed commercial conditions and are aligned with GSMA standards and RAEX processes.

• Monitor contract lifecycle and proactively manage renewals and amendments.

•
Financial Reconciliation & Settlements:

• Perform regular reconciliations between operational and financial data (e.g., invoices, payments, service delivery, usage reports).

• Validate and process settlement reports, ensuring accuracy of financial postings and balances.

• Perform Monthly Accruals for discounted commercial deals.

• Support monthly and quarterly financial closing activities, ensuring all settlements are captured and accrued correctly.

•
Commercial Strategy & Analysis:

• Analyse roaming traffic, cost trends, and partner performance to identify negotiation opportunities.

• Collaborate with finance, pricing, and analytics teams to model commercial scenarios and assess impact on customer P&L.

• Support the development of roaming pricing strategies and discount frameworks.

•
Stakeholder Engagement:

• Maintain strong working relationships with internal stakeholders (e.g., finance, legal, operations) and external roaming partners.

• Provide regular updates and reporting to the customer on negotiation progress, risks, and outcomes.

•
Market Intelligence & Compliance:

• Stay informed on industry trends, regulatory developments, and competitive benchmarks.

• Ensure all agreements comply with GSMA guidelines, roaming regulations, and internal governance.

Qualifications

• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Business, Economics, Telecommunications, or related field

• 3-7 years of experience in roaming, wholesale, or telecom commercial roles

• Experience negotiating IOT agreements or managing roaming partnerships

• Fluency in verbal and spoken English; additional languages are a plus

• Strong presentation skills

Personal Skills

•
Growth Mindset: Eager to learn, adapt, and continuously improve negotiation strategies and outcomes

•
Can-Do Attitude: Proactive, solution-oriented, and resilient in the face of challenges

•
Accountability: Takes ownership of deliverables and follows

title: Executive Partner - PH

They're captains in their own right , trusted to think ahead, own outcomes, and grow alongside the leaders they support.

As an Executive Partner, you'll be the strategic right hand to a US-based founder or CEO - anticipating needs before they're voiced, protecting their time like it's your own, and becoming the person they can't imagine running their business without. This isn't a task-execution role. It's a seat at the table.

• Strategic calendar and inbox management, triaging what matters, filtering out what doesn't

• Executive-ready research, reports, and presentations that drive real decisions

• Cross-functional coordination across the exec's business and personal priorities

• Travel, logistics, and meeting coordination with zero dropped balls

• Acting as a trusted gatekeeper and first point of contact on the exec's behalf

• Proactively spotting opportunities to make the exec's life and business run better

Requirements

•
3+ years supporting a founder/CEO or C-suite exec - ideally with progression from assistant into a chief-of-staff or Executive Partner-level role

•
End-to-end ownership , not single-task support - you've run inbox, calendar, CRM, and client comms as whole workflows, not waited for instructions

•
A named system , not just good instincts - a repeatable framework for inbox triage, calendar management, and prioritizing strategic vs. operational vs. urgent

•
Voice-matching ability - you can study how an exec writes and draft on their behalf convincingly

•
External representation experience - you've stood in for an exec on client calls, meetings, or board settings, not just scheduled them

•
Tool fluency that goes deep - CRM and task management platforms (Asana, Monday, ClickUp) you've configured, not just used

•
A real story of composure under pressure - a time something slipped, how you owned it, and what changed after

•
Evidence of moving up the value chain - building a tool, catching an issue early, proposing a project unprompted

•
A quantifiable track record - specific outcomes tied to your own contribution, not team results

Benefits

•
Probationary period (first 3 months): $900 USD/month (approx. ₱54,000 PHP)

•
Post-probationary: $1,100 USD/month (approx. ₱66,000 PHP)

•
Paid time off on all observed US Holidays

•
Health Benefit of up to $600 USD annually, active from month six

Why Moonlight

•
Global talent, global standards. We source Executive Partners worldwide - this isn't a single-market pipeline, it's a global bench of top-tier talent.

•
Real partnership, not gig work. You're matched long-term with one executive, not rotated across accounts.

•
Built-in growth path. Clear pay progression after probation, health coverage, and a team that invests in where you're headed next - not just what you can do today.

•
Boutique means personal. Small, high-touch team. You're never a ticket number.

Ready to become someone's indispensable right hand? Apply today and let's see if it's a match.
Moonlight is an equal opportunity employer sourcing talent globally. We evaluate every candidate on merit, judgment, and fit - not geography.

title: Content Editor, Tech
description:
Hi, we're TechnologyAdvice .

Headquartered in Nashville, Tennessee, TechnologyAdvice helps millions of B2B technology buyers make smarter decisions by providing trusted research, practical guidance, and connections to the world's leading technology brands. Our work spans 30+ media brands and 50+ newsletters, supported by a global team across the United States, United Kingdom, Singapore, Australia, and the Philippines.

We're a remote-first company that values curiosity, collaboration, and growth. We invest in our people, embrace AI and new technologies to improve how we work, and create opportunities for team members to build meaningful careers. Many of our leaders have grown from within, including our CEO, who started here as an intern.

We believe great work happens when people feel connected. Through company all-hands, team events, Slack communities, learning sessions, and in-person gatherings, we create intentional opportunities for our global team to collaborate, build relationships, and celebrate successes together.

All positions are open to remote work unless otherwise specified in the requirements below.

The opportunity
We’re hiring a Content Editor to support DZone’s editorial and contributor operations across both site and commercial content programs.

This role is ideal for someone who combines strong editorial instincts with technical curiosity and excellent organizational skills. You will help manage and publish technical content for DZone’s developer audience while also coordinating contributor-driven commercial projects from kickoff through completion.

You will work closely with editorial, audience, sales, and contributor stakeholders to ensure content is accurate, engaging, timely, and aligned with DZone’s standards.

This requires excellent copyediting skills, strong project management abilities, comfort working with technical subject matter, and the ability to balance multiple priorities in a fast-moving publishing environment.
Employment Level: Mid-level
Employment Type: Full-time
Location: Philippines
Working Hours: 9pm to 6am PHT (APR-OCT) or 10pm to 7am PHT (NOV-MAR)
What you'll do
Site Content and Community

• Select, copyedit, and prepare technical site content for publication on DZone.

• Research trends in the SDLC and stay up to date with the latest innovations to support article planning, content strategies, newsletters, and community initiatives.

• Update site pages daily with fresh content and help ensure published content is timely, relevant, and aligned with editorial standards.

• Monitor support and editor inboxes, answer inquiries, delete spam, and escalate issues to the appropriate departments.

• Work with appropriate stakeholders to suggest site articles, community content, and other relevant editorial content to be featured in newsletters.

• Build and maintain relationships with contributors, authors, and community members.

• Support community-focused editorial initiatives, contributor engagement, and other programming that strengthen the DZone audience.

• Assist with other team projects and initiatives as needed.

Commercial Content

• Recommend contributors for relevant Commercial Content opportunities and lead contributor outreach.

• Manage contributor-driven Commercial Content projects from kickoff through completion.

• Vet, commission, onboard, and coordinate with contributors throughout the project lifecycle.

• Prepare and send contributor-facing materials, including project briefs, authorship templates, launch emails, and related communications.

• Manage editorial reviews and provide clear feedback to contributors; review outlines and drafts to ensure content aligns with project goals, audience needs, and editorial expectations.

• Track contributor outreach, project status, deadlines, revisions, and completion details in the appropriate systems.

• Maintain contributor records, project documentation, content versions, and related files in the correct storage locations.
